correctness.rationale: A complete proof checks every single-position deletion: untouched later exact period rejects middle-copy edits; finite-word suffix comparison at the unique shortened run determines first-/last-copy eligibility; suffixes beginning inside the minimum-letter run are handled separately. Direct exhaustive and seeded tests corroborate 2447 finite parameter configurations and 76876 individual deletion candidates.

value.rationale: A complete all-maximizer classification on a natural infinite-parameter family for the longest Lyndon subsequence problem. The switching of permissible deletion copy at ascents versus descents produces two exact, distinct invariants (p physical sites and q different optimum output words), whereas the generic optimization algorithm only returns a longest example. The statement remains quantitative and position-sensitive for arbitrarily large repetitions and run lengths.
